summary: Caldwell Parish lookout that Forest Lookouts marks removed, with no date; no builder, staffing or fire history found, and no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed, with no date; no source describes what, if anything, remains

evidence.quote: Holum Lookout Tower is a tower in Caldwell

evidence.supports: Holum hamlet about 4.5 miles northwest of the point

corrections.why: The agency field holds the township, range and section from the Forest Lookouts page, which is a land location, not an agency. No source read names an agency for Holum.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only lookout-specific source is the Forest Lookouts entry (removed, no date, land location only). Mapcarta lists a point named Holum Lookout Tower typed as a tower; its underlying map data is crowd-sourced and it does not show a structure, so the story says so. The Pastmaps page supports only the settlement name. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Two web searches; no NHLR, FFLOS, newspaper or agency record for Holum turned up. The editor could drop the Mapcarta paragraph if they judge it misleading.
